entity similarity never authorises silent merge

unknown, contested, stale and revoked evidence fails closed
workspace facts cannot mutate canonical evidence directly
workers remain bounded and cannot approve external action

external outreach, signatures and transactions are human-only
observed outcomes remain distinct from forecasts and intentions

invariants: registry jurisdiction and identifier namespace are explicit
candidate matches never silently merge entities
name similarity alone cannot establish identity

tenant-private annotations cannot mutate global entity identity

filing publication is distinct from regulator acceptance or legal effectiveness
document anchors bind source version, passage and digest
missing disclosure values remain unknown rather than zero
machine extraction remains candidate-only until independent admission
observed legal ownership and inferred control remain distinct
ownership percentage, voting rights and economic interest remain distinct
direct, indirect and ultimate ownership are not collapsed
beneficial ownership requires an authorised source and purpose
conflicting ownership assertions remain contested
ownership chains preserve jurisdiction, time and evidence lineage
appointment, role, signing authority and beneficial ownership remain distinct
natural-person data is minimised and purpose-bound
public office data does not authorise unrestricted enrichment
appointment announcement is not appointment effectiveness
resignation and disqualification terminate contribution after effective time
models cannot infer personal relationships or hidden control
announced, agreed, approved and completed transactions remain distinct
capital target, committed amount and received proceeds remain distinct
currency, valuation date and stated basis are preserved
acquisition rumours cannot become transaction facts
regulatory approval cannot be inferred from transaction announcement
restatements and cancellations supersede but do not erase prior evidence
workspace is tenant-scoped and server-resolved
account thesis separates observed facts, calculations, inferences and unknowns
pursuit decisions bind current evidence and explicit dissent
account readiness never implies contact or transaction authority
private CRM knowledge cannot become global canonical evidence
imports retain candidate-only authority and source rights
signals remain linked to source, event time and retrieval time
relationship maps distinguish observed, declared and inferred links
stale or revoked signals contribute zero to readiness
risk labels cannot become credit ratings or legal conclusions
monitoring alerts do not fabricate materiality
unknown counterparties and identifiers remain unresolved
external action requires a typed human authority and current approvals
workers and models cannot contact, transact, sign or represent the organisation
channel, recipient and purpose must be verified before action
outcomes require observed evidence and cannot be self-declared by models
imported approvals and outcomes have no live authority
audit events are append-only, hash-linked and secret-free

rules: current filing versions supersede but never erase historical versions
rejected opportunities require an explicit reason
approval requires a current evidence-linked decision record
closed accounts may return to monitoring only through a new observed signal
unknown or contested ownership blocks control-dependent action
external action is never a lifecycle transition performed by a model or worker
client-supplied tenant or workspace identifiers have no authority
natural-person processing requires purpose, legal basis and minimisation
canonical entity, ownership and filing writes require independent admission
external action requires typed current human approval
financial commitments require independent finance authority
legal conclusions and transaction authority remain human-only
unknown or indeterminate authority is denied
